message: recursive `rm` on a path that begins with `$BUILD`, which may be empty or unexpected; a recursive delete there can remove far more than intended, name an explicit literal subpath
help: quote the variable and guard it: `test -n "$X" && rm -rf -- "$X/sub"`, or name a literal subpath such as `rm -rf ./build`
notes: a recursive delete whose path can be empty, `/`, `~` or `.` is a never event: one unset variable removes everything
